risks.risk: The projector may not power on or project an image due to internal damage or lamp failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the projector turning on, projecting an image, and displaying the WXGA resolution on a screen.

risks.risk: The lamp may be near end-of-life or already failed, reducing brightness and image quality.
risks.proof: A video of the projector in use showing brightness and color accuracy, or a photo of the lamp hours display if available.

risks.risk: Ports may be damaged or non-functional, especially HDMI or VGA, affecting connectivity.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of each port with a cable inserted and connected to a device showing output.

proof_requests: Video of the projector turning on and projecting a clear image.
Photo or video showing the lamp hours or condition.
Close-up of each port with a cable connected and working.
response.reason: The model and brand are clearly identified from the photos. While performance claims are unverifiable remotely, the item can be priced at its worst case (not working or reduced brightness) based on visible condition and model. Hidden risks are listed with required proof to raise the price.
